paragraphs: Rav Chiyya the Tall. His mother-in-law had been his brother's wife; his brother died childless and Rav Chiyya inherited him. She sued him before Rabbah bar Shila. He came before Rava: Ketubot 104b. R. Yitzchak ben Tavli, in his name. This requires investigation, since R. Yitzchak ben Tavli appears earlier than he; see R. Shimon bar Rav Zevid.
